author: marthomahew
name: modslash
short: Slash command versions of Red's moderation commands.
description: Adds /ban, /kick, /tempban, /softban, /unban, /warn, /warnings, /unwarn, /mute, /timeout, /unmute, /slowmode and /purge. Each runs Red's own Mod, Warnings or Mutes command underneath, so modlog cases, warnings and settings work exactly like the ! versions.
install_msg: Loaded? As bot owner run `[p]slash enablecog modslash` then `[p]slash sync`. Discord can take a minute to show the new commands.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data.
